scope: Archived-table aggregation and physical-link cluster-bootstrap recomputation

definitions.constant_offset: Unweighted OLS across one full-period mean attenuation and radar-expected attenuation per sublink
definitions.radar_amplitude_free: OLS on kL, with wet periods and clear-sky reference selection retaining radar input
definitions.short_path_share: Median across sublinks of W / att_mean, using right-closed length intervals
definitions.event_count: Sum of retained wet segments counted separately for each sublink, with independent weather-process count unavailable
definitions.evaluation_rmse: Median of per-sublink hourly RMSE within each length class
definitions.evaluation_cumulative_ratio: Median of per-sublink accumulated-link / accumulated-radar ratios
definitions.evaluation_label_usage: Radar-centered wet masks and radar-confirmed dry outputs of zero are also used in August
definitions.support_checks: Counts and radar accumulation totals are compared across methods, while timestamp checks require hourly inputs
definitions.calibration_csv_dtype: The q1 and q2 calibration attenuation means are restored to their original float32 dtype before fitting
definitions.budget_rain_rate_conversion: Standalone equivalent rain rate (attenuation / kL) ** (1 / alpha)

outside_this_audit: Raw observations, minute aggregation, radar sampling, wet/dry masks, and individual reference windows
Per-event quantization RMS and dither predictions stored in events.csv.gz
Regression and bootstrap of rain-rate-bin curves from bins.csv
Sensitivity reruns from the original minute cache
NR waveform generation and estimation samples underlying pilot_reference.csv

offset.bootstrap_cluster: physical Link, with both directions kept together
